summary.text: Tony Rivero is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 27; he assumed office on January 13, 2025.

paragraphs.text: He previously represented District 21 in the Arizona House from 2015 to 2021.
He was born in Peoria, Arizona, graduated from Peoria High School, and earned a bachelor's degree in education and a master's in public administration from Arizona State University.
His career experience includes working in the Peoria City Manager's office and other city departments.
He advanced from the July 21, 2026 Republican primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
